EB-03 is in and verified. Try it at **http://maker:4001/?demo=edge** — a **Sort by** control sits just above the list:

1. Switch it between **Newest first**, **Oldest first**, **Recently updated**, **Title A–Z**, and **Title Z–A**, and watch the order change.
2. Notice the chosen order **carries across** views and applies to your search results too — e.g. set **Title A–Z**, then open the **Archive**, and it stays sorted that way.

A couple of things to confirm:

- **The set of orders** — Newest first, Oldest first, Recently updated, Title A–Z, Title Z–A. Is that the right menu, or is there another order you'd reach for (and are any of these unnecessary)?
- The sort is a small **"Sort by" dropdown** above the list, it applies to whatever view/search you're in, and defaults to **Newest first**. Does that placement and default suit you? (Later, in preferences, you'll be able to set your own default order.)

If that's good, I'll record EB-03 and move to **EB-04 — selecting several bookmarks and acting on them together.**
